Manifest.Name: 垃圾场拾荒地图 / Dumping Ground Map
Manifest.Author: Local
Manifest.Description: 前往垃圾场时先打开地图选一块地标，确认后进入该区域，之后拾荒不再询问，本次停留内连续沿用；离开垃圾场后重新选择。每个区域有独立的物品权重表，出厂默认下四区单次拾荒价值同为约 12.26，差异只在捡到什么。所有掉落调节都在游戏的模组设置窗口里：垃圾出现率倍率、高档物资出现率、区域专精度三条全局滑条。区域专精度（0–100%）是一条对四个区通用的设置，决定这一趟捡到的东西里、除垃圾之外有多少是本区才有的特色物品：0% 保持默认混搭，越高外地的普通物品越按比例让位给本区特色物品，100% 时除垃圾外只出本区的东西；四个区各有一份自己的特色清单，所以同一个数值在四个区会捡到不同的东西。垃圾是单独一档，只受垃圾倍率影响。高档物资没有保底，只有出现率一条概率设置。高档池已剔除剧情物品与功能装置（给埃莉诺的慰问包裹、成分光谱仪），现为 7 件纯可回收物资。每条数值直接显示在滑条右侧；末尾用「默认 → 现在」直白列出同一数值下四区各自的结果、四区平均与三个预设。拖动时实时刷新，松手或点「应用」才写盘。 / When travelling to the Dumping Ground, pick a landmark first and enter that area; later searches reuse it for the rest of the visit, and the choice resets when you leave. Each area has its own weight table; by default all four are worth about 12.26 per search and differ only in what you find. All loot tuning lives in the game's mod settings window: junk chance multiplier, high-value chance and one shared region specialty. Region specialty (0-100%) applies to all four areas and decides how much of the haul, junk aside, is something only found in this region: 0% keeps the default mix, higher values make out-of-region goods yield proportionally to the region's own items, and at 100% only the region's own items (plus junk) remain. Each area has its own list, so one shared number still yields different goods per region. Junk is a separate tier controlled only by the junk multiplier. High-value finds have no pity: a single chance setting controls them. Each value is shown right next to its slider. The bottom lists "default -> now" for all four areas at the current number, the four-area average and three presets. Everything refreshes while dragging; the config is written on release or when Apply is pressed.
